json_ld_descriptions: Facing charges in The Bronx or elsewhere can feel overwhelming, as if the odds are against you. Your reputation, liberty, and future hang in the balance. However, there’s no need to rely on uncertainty or vague information. David Mejia Colgan, Esq. is available to clarify the situation and provide a concrete plan for your next steps. He dedicates time to explain the charges in both English and Spanish, outlines the legal system, details your rights, listens to your narrative, and helps you visualize a clear and confident path forward. The approach is relaxed and straightforward, focusing on honest communication and effective strategies. The process begins with a consultation where you will receive a clear breakdown of the legal proceedings, an assessment of your situation, and guidance on what to do next. With more than 30 years in the field and a background as a former Assistant District Attorney, David Mejia Colgan, Esq. is a highly regarded criminal defense lawyer in The Bronx who will ensure that your case receives personalized care from day one.
